text: Without the promise of improving reputation, a zero-sum mentality dominates a contractual arrangement and each party's best strategy becomes exerting the absolute minimum effort while still technically fulfilling the contract, which destroys the business atmosphere.
citation: Craig Calcaterra, Wulf A. Kaal, The Importance of Reputation for the Evolution of Decentralization (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3782210

isBasedOn.name: The Importance of Reputation for the Evolution of Decentralization

abstract: With- out the promise of improving your reputation, a zero-sum mentality dominates the arrangement. Both parties' best strategy becomes exerting the absolute minimum of effort while still technically fulfilling the stipulations of the contract.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: contracts between parties with no expectation of reputational gain
